f_out_of_reach.speaker: narrator
f_out_of_reach.text: You can't reach that from where you are.

f_object_unknown.speaker: narrator
f_object_unknown.text: You don't know what that is.

f_not_portable.speaker: narrator
f_not_portable.text: That isn't something you can pick up.

f_nothing_to_hide.speaker: narrator
f_nothing_to_hide.text: That isn't something you can hide.

f_asleep.speaker: narrator
f_asleep.text: You're too far under to do anything about it.

l_first.speaker: narrator
l_first.text: You take it in properly for the first time.

l_open.speaker: narrator
l_open.text: It's open. You can see what's inside.

l_clock.speaker: narrator
l_clock.text: The clock is across the room. You can read it from here, just.

h_here.speaker: player_thought
h_here.text: She's here. There's nothing to listen for.

h_stairs.speaker: narrator
h_stairs.text: The staircase creaks. She's coming up.

h_washing.speaker: narrator
h_washing.text: Water running, somewhere below. It'll cover a lot.

h_tv.speaker: narrator
h_tv.text: The television, muffled, two floors down.

h_cooking.speaker: narrator
h_cooking.text: Movement in the kitchen. A cupboard, then a pan.

h_cleaning.speaker: narrator
h_cleaning.text: Something being dragged across a floor below you.

h_phone.speaker: narrator
h_phone.text: Her voice, downstairs. One side of a conversation.

h_away.speaker: narrator
h_away.text: Nothing at all. The house is empty under you.

o_heard.speaker: narrator
o_heard.text: The drawer is louder than you expected.

d_generic.speaker: narrator
d_generic.text: You put it out of sight.

r_generic.speaker: narrator
r_generic.text: You sleep, and it's dark when you stop.

r_pain.speaker: narrator
r_pain.text: You rest. It helps, a little.

lamp_off.speaker: narrator
lamp_off.text: The lamp goes off. The window is the only light left.

j_blank.speaker: narrator
j_blank.text: Blank, except for what you've put in it.

j_moved.speaker: narrator
j_moved.text: It isn't where you left it.

late_open.speaker: her
late_open.text: She stops at the nightstand. "This was shut when I left."

late_take.speaker: her
late_take.text: She looks at the space where it was. "Where has it gone?"

late_move.speaker: her
late_move.text: She puts it back where it was, without a word.

late_hide.speaker: her
late_hide.text: She stops halfway across the room and looks at the floor.

f_not_a_thing.speaker: narrator
f_not_a_thing.text: She isn't something you can move.

her_warm.speaker: narrator
her_warm.text: She's sitting down, unhurried. Coat off, hours to spare.

her_excited.speaker: narrator
her_excited.text: She's talking fast, and she's brought something up with her.

her_irritated.speaker: narrator
her_irritated.text: She keeps straightening things that were already straight.

her_angry.speaker: narrator
her_angry.text: She came up fast. The stairs are still settling.

her_sad.speaker: narrator
her_sad.text: She hasn't turned the lamp on. She doesn't seem to have noticed.

her_worried.speaker: narrator
her_worried.text: She's asked how you're feeling twice now.

her_absent.speaker: narrator
her_absent.text: She's here, doing something with her hands. You can't read her.

watch_generic.speaker: narrator
watch_generic.text: You watch her work. She doesn't look up.

watch_noticed.speaker: her
watch_noticed.text: She catches you looking and holds it a moment too long.

thanks_warm.speaker: her
thanks_warm.text: "You don't have to keep saying that."

thanks_flat.speaker: her
thanks_flat.text: She nods, and carries on with what she was doing.

offer_food_any.speaker: her
offer_food_any.text: She sets a bowl on the nightstand and waits.

offer_food_warm.speaker: her
offer_food_warm.text: "I made too much. You'll help me with it."

offer_water_any.speaker: her
offer_water_any.text: She holds the glass where you can reach it.

offer_pills_any.speaker: her
offer_pills_any.text: She shakes two out into her palm and holds them out.

offer_pills_pain.speaker: her
offer_pills_pain.text: "Don't be brave about it. I can tell."

offer_dressing.speaker: her
offer_dressing.text: She unwraps the leg without asking, and starts.

ate.speaker: narrator
ate.text: You eat what she brought. She watches until the bowl is empty.

drank.speaker: narrator
drank.text: You drink. She takes the glass back before you've quite finished.

swallowed.speaker: narrator
swallowed.text: You swallow them. The edge comes off the leg, and off everything else.

dressed.speaker: narrator
dressed.text: She works on the leg. It takes a while, and she is careful with it.

refused_panic.speaker: her
refused_panic.text: "Why not? Is it the taste? I'll make something else."

refused_hard.speaker: her
refused_hard.text: She puts it down harder than she needs to.

palmed.speaker: narrator
palmed.text: You take them, and they don't go where she thinks they go.

palmed_caught.speaker: her
palmed_caught.text: She takes your wrist and turns it over. Neither of you says anything.

watch_again.speaker: narrator
watch_again.text: She's doing what she was doing before.

nail_outline_first.speaker: narrator
nail_outline_first.text: A nail, and around it a patch of wallpaper a shade lighter than the rest. Whatever hung there hung there a long time, and came down recently.

nail_outline_again.speaker: narrator
nail_outline_again.text: The same nail. The same clean rectangle around it.

nail_ask_deflect.speaker: her
nail_ask_deflect.text: "Oh — that's been there for ages. I keep meaning to fill it in."

f_dont_know_that_yet.speaker: narrator
f_dont_know_that_yet.text: You don't have a reason to ask that.

d1_wake_1.speaker: narrator
d1_wake_1.text: You come up out of it slowly. Bare rafters close overhead, and a ceiling that slopes away on both sides to meet a floor you can't see the edge of.

d1_wake_2.speaker: narrator
d1_wake_2.text: Your left leg is splinted from the ankle to above the knee and packed straight. You try to move it. You get about an inch.

d1_wake_3.speaker: narrator
d1_wake_3.text: At the far end of the room the floor simply stops. Stairs go down into the gap. No door at the top, no rail, no gate — just the opening and the drop.

day_open_any.speaker: narrator
day_open_any.text: You surface. The light through the dormer has moved.

day_open_3.speaker: narrator
day_open_3.text: Third morning. You know the shape of the ceiling now without looking at it.

stairs_any.speaker: narrator
stairs_any.text: Below you, the staircase takes her weight. One step, then another, in no hurry.

stairs_angry.speaker: narrator
stairs_angry.text: The stairs go fast under her, and she isn't being quiet about it.

stairs_excited.speaker: narrator
stairs_excited.text: She comes up quick and light, two at a time by the sound of it.

enters_any.speaker: narrator
enters_any.text: Her head clears the stairwell, and she is looking at the bed before the rest of her is in the room.

enters_warm.speaker: narrator
enters_warm.text: She comes up, and stops at the top for a moment to look at you before she says anything.

enters_irritated.speaker: narrator
enters_irritated.text: She's in the room before you've finished hearing her. She looks the room over first, and you second.

enters_angry.speaker: narrator
enters_angry.text: She comes off the last step and stands there. She hasn't said anything yet.

expl_1.speaker: her
expl_1.text: "You're awake. Don't sit up — I mean it. Don't."

expl_2.speaker: her
expl_2.text: "You broke your leg. Badly. I've set it and splinted it and it will hold, but not if you go walking around on it."

expl_3.speaker: her
expl_3.text: "I found you. That's all there is to it. Nobody else had stopped."

expl_4.speaker: her
expl_4.text: "I'm a nurse. Fifteen years of it. You've had better luck than you know."

expl_5.speaker: her
expl_5.text: "And before you ask — you could go to a hospital. They'd bill you for the ambulance before they got as far as the bed."

expl_6.speaker: her
expl_6.text: "I'm not charging you anything, and I'm not going to."

expl_7.speaker: her
expl_7.text: "Give it a few weeks. When you can stand on it, you walk out of here on your own two feet."

goes_any.speaker: narrator
goes_any.text: She goes down. The sound of her thins out, floor by floor, and then the house is quiet.

goes_warm.speaker: her
goes_warm.text: "I won't be long." And the stairs take her.

goes_irritated.speaker: narrator
goes_irritated.text: She goes without saying anything. The stairs are loud on the way down.

night_any.speaker: narrator
night_any.text: She turns the light off at the top of the stairs, and the room goes.

night_d1.speaker: narrator
night_d1.text: She said she found you in the road. There is no dirt on you anywhere. Somebody washed you.

kit_first.speaker: narrator
kit_first.text: It isn't a household first aid box. It's a proper trauma kit — the sort that gets carried to people rather than kept in a cupboard. Half of it has been used.

kit_again.speaker: narrator
kit_again.text: The same kit, open, with the same gap in it.

kit_ask.speaker: her
kit_ask.text: "Work. They throw things out when they're near the date. I'd be mad not to take them."

kit_ask_again.speaker: her
kit_ask_again.text: "I've told you where it came from."

howlong_any.speaker: her
howlong_any.text: "Six weeks for the bone. Longer before I'd trust you on those stairs."

whoknows_any.speaker: her
whoknows_any.text: She thinks about it a moment. "I don't know who'd be looking. Do you?"

l_stairwell.speaker: narrator
l_stairwell.text: An opening in the floor with a steep run of steps going down out of it. No door, no gate, nothing across it. For a leg like yours it isn't a way out, it's a fall.

l_stairwell_dark.speaker: narrator
l_stairwell_dark.text: You can make out where the floor ends, and nothing past it.

l_leg.speaker: narrator
l_leg.text: Splinted straight from the ankle to above the knee, and strapped. The work is neat. Whoever did it had done it before.

l_leg_pain.speaker: narrator
l_leg_pain.text: It has its own pulse today, and it is louder than yours.
